dedupe_keys.name: drag based model with constant solar wind speed

description: DBM predicts propagation and arrival of an interplanetary coronal mass ejection under an aerodynamic-drag approximation. Users specify event and solar-wind conditions for an ecliptic-plane trajectory. The resource is documented by Hvar Observatory. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented model assumes constant background wind and drag and a symmetric CME in two dimensions. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
